title: Newly Acquired Vehicles under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Provision.** A newly acquired vehicle is automatically covered for collision and comprehensive from its acquisition date, provided Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage is carried on at least one vehicle already scheduled on the policy. During that automatic period a loss carries the newly acquired vehicle deductible (500 USD on every deductible option). To keep physical damage from the acquisition date, the customer must ask for it within the reporting window.

**Reporting window.** Physical damage takes effect on the acquisition date only when it is requested no later than the reporting window (14 calendar days on every deductible option) after the customer acquired the vehicle. The count starts on the acquisition date of the vehicle record as day 0, and a request on the last day of the window is in time. A request after the window starts physical damage on the request date, and no automatic coverage applies to a loss before then. If no vehicle on the policy carries physical damage, a newly acquired vehicle has no automatic physical damage at all.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Physical damage on another scheduled vehicle | Request made | Physical damage starts | Loss before the request date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | On or before day 14 | Acquisition date | Covered, with the newly acquired vehicle deductible during the automatic period |
| Yes | Day 15 or later | Request date | No automatic coverage |
| No | Any day | — | No automatic physical damage at all |

The acquisition date is taken from the vehicle record, not from the customer's recollection.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Vehicle acquired on day 0, request on day 14: in time; physical damage takes effect on the acquisition date.
- Vehicle acquired on day 0, request on day 15: late; physical damage starts on day 15 and a loss on day 10 has no automatic coverage.
- Vehicle acquired while no vehicle on the policy carries physical damage: no automatic physical damage, whatever the request date.
